description: Auto-QA self-tuning configuration for tuna-os/.github. Consumed by the ACMM L4 auto-QA self-tuning harness (criterion acmm:auto-qa-tuning, tracked in issue #56); not yet read by any workflow in this repository — it is consumed when that self-tuning job lands. Thresholds are the L4 self-tuning targets: 0.95 pass-rate, 0.8 min quality score, 0.6 escalation.
